title: Ryan Prepared for the 90-Day Blackout
description: Ryan believed the viral November 17 '90-day blackout' rumour and bought 40 candles and 200 cans of beans. Maya traces the rumour to its four ingredients — a one-minute Emergency Alert System test, a Simpsons episode, the Pentagon's FORTRESS plan and a week of outages — explains how the US power grid really works, and what preparing for a real outage actually looks like.

seo.title: The Simpsons Prediction: Real Blackout or Just a Test?
seo.description: The Simpsons seemingly predicted a grid blackout, causing panic over beans and generators! 📺⚡ But before you stockpile, watch to learn why this is just the annual Emergency Alert System test at 2:20 PM ET. 🔊 Hear that loud tone? It's FEMA and FCC testing the warning system, not a disaster scenario. We break down the truth behind the viral rumor, explain why no action is required, and share critical safety tips for generators.
